instructions: Start with a blank pdf project for edit-new?pdfjs=1
Click the Password tool in the floating toolbar
The tool is not premium-gated and neither endpoint bills the account, so every case runs as a guest
Setting, updating and removing the password only hashes it onto the documents row, so those run for real; only Download PDF runs encrypt_pdf.py, which case 11 exercises
Cases 06-11 depend on the app's session-scoped unlock token; each runs in its own browser context

tests.title: Setup: blank PDF project loads with the Password tool available
tests.summary: Precondition for the whole story: the page rasterises, the floating toolbar Password button is present, enabled and not premium-locked, it announces the dialog it opens (aria-haspopup, aria-controls), the dialog is in the DOM but closed, the document starts unprotected, both endpoints are wired on the root, and the console is clean.

tests.title: The dialog opens on Set, focuses New password, and closes via X, scrim and Escape
tests.summary: The button opens the dialog titled Password on the Set tab with only that panel on show, focus lands in New password, and the button reports itself pressed. The two notices (no recovery, AES-128) are on show. X, the scrim and Escape each close it; a click inside the card does not; closing returns focus to the button, clears what was typed, and resets the pressed state.

tests.title: Set and Remove tabs switch by click and arrow keys, and Remove is inert until a password exists
tests.summary: Remove shows its panel and hides Set, aria-selected and a roving tabindex mark exactly one tab, and ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move between them. On an unprotected document the Remove tab says Set a password first and its button never enables, whatever is typed.

tests.title: Set is gated on a new password with a matching confirmation, and Enter submits
tests.summary: Set password stays disabled until New password has a value and Confirm password matches it exactly; a later mismatch disables it again. Enter in a field submits when the button is enabled and does nothing when it is not, and typing after a refusal clears the error.

tests.title: The request carries action, algorithm, persist_protection and both passwords, and the dialog flips to Update
tests.summary: Set posts one multipart request with action=set, algorithm=aes-128, persist_protection=1, password and password_confirmation, and no PDF or current password. On success the dialog stays open reporting Password set, the editor status agrees, the fields are cleared, and the Set tab becomes Update password with a Current password field in place of the confirmation; Remove now asks for the current password.

tests.title: A protected document asks for its password before it renders; a wrong password is refused, the right one opens it
tests.summary: Exercised for real: after setting a password, reloading shows the Unlock prompt (title Unlock PDF, tabs hidden, Open PDF disabled until a value) before any page is drawn. A wrong password is refused with Password is incorrect and the prompt stays; the right one closes it and the PDF renders. The dialog then opens in Update mode.

tests.title: Cancelling the unlock prompt leaves the editor
tests.summary: By design there is no way past the prompt without the password: Escape, X and the scrim on the Unlock prompt each navigate away to the editor home rather than reveal the document.

tests.title: Protection is per session: a fresh session must unlock again, and the file URL is 423 without a token
tests.summary: The unlock token lives in the session. A fresh browser context opening the same document gets the prompt again, its request for the PDF file answers 423 until it unlocks, and even the session that set the password gets 423 when it asks for the file without presenting its token.

tests.title: The current password is required and checked; after updating, only the new password unlocks
tests.summary: With protection active the Set tab reads Update password, shows Current password, hides the confirmation, and stays disabled until both fields have a value. A wrong current password is refused with Current password is incorrect; the right one reports Password updated. Proved for real: a fresh session is refused with the old password and opens with the new one.

tests.title: The current password is required and checked; after removing, the document reopens without a prompt
tests.summary: The Remove tab asks for the current password and stays disabled without it. A wrong password is refused with Current password is incorrect; the right one reports Password removed, the editor status agrees, and the dialog returns to a plain Set tab. Proved for real: a reload draws the page with no prompt and the root reports the document unprotected.

tests.title: Download PDF on a protected document is encrypted with its password, and plain again after removal
tests.summary: Exercised for real against encrypt_pdf.py: with a password set, Download PDF reports Password-protected PDF ready and the file it builds carries an /Encrypt dictionary while keeping its page count; after the password is removed the same button reports PDF ready and the file has no /Encrypt.

tests.title: A request in progress disables the dialog until it settles
tests.summary: While the request is held open the submit is disabled and marked busy, every field, both tabs and the close button are disabled, and the status says what is happening. Everything comes back once the response lands.

tests.title: A failed request shows the server's message and leaves the dialog usable
tests.summary: A 500 puts the server's message in the alert, clears the progress status, keeps the dialog open with the typed values, and re-enables the controls. A 422 with validation errors shows the first validation message rather than a generic one.

tests.title: Keyboard access and ARIA on the dialog, tabs, fields and messages
tests.summary: The card is a labelled and described modal dialog; the tablist has a name and its tabs name real tabpanels; every field is a labelled password input with an autocomplete hint; the error is a role=alert that is hidden while empty and the status a polite live region; the close button and the toolbar button have accessible names; and a focused tab activates from the keyboard.
